t: None of the funds appropriated by this Act for programs of the Central Intelligence Agency shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year, except for funds appropriated for the Reserve for Contingencies, which shall remain available until September 30, 2002: Provided, That funds appropriated, transferred, or otherwise credited to the Central Intelligence Agency Central Services Working Capital Fund during this or any prior or subsequent fiscal year shall remain available until expended.

fable.w: This section only sets the period of availability for CIA appropriations and the Working Capital Fund. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting reading here; the word "programs" does not imply any outside-party process.
fable.s: None of the funds appropriated by this Act for programs of the Central Intelligence Agency shall remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year
